title: U.S. to issue visas to Flávio Bolsonaro as his whereabouts remain unclear
content: Flávio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for the U.S. amid a money-laundering probe, as Washington agrees to issue visas to him and his family.

title: Southwest flood damage estimates are hundreds of millions for New Mexico alone
content: Intense rainstorms linked to a very active El Niño-driven Pacific hurricane season have left thousands of people in the Four Corners states displaced.

title: Israel's voter turnout soars as Netanyahu faces a tight election
content: Israelis voted in their highest numbers in over two decades in a tense national election to decide whether to stick with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition.

title: The Ebola outbreak is breaking records -- and just marked a grim milestone
content: The current outbreak, first identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has now counted 10,000 patients and has spread with great speed. How can it be stopped?

title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
content: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.

title: Bolsonaro's party accepts Brazil election defeat, but he refuses to concede
content: Brazil's opposition party accepts President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's election victory, but Flávio Bolsonaro won't concede, while President Trump calls the vote "rigged" without offering evidence.

title: Discursive Verses: Jay-Z, the Super Bowl and playing with house money
content: NPR Music culture critic and reporter Rodney Carmichael ruminates on the latest in rap culture. This week: Is the rap mogul's self-selection a crowning achievement or a final affront?

title: A 'Green Army' is out to thwart El Niño flooding
content: In Nairobi, a city prone to floods, workers in the "Green Army" are making preparations to prevent disaster when El Niño arrives.

title: Democrats have a midterm edge, poll shows. And, Israelis vote in high-stakes election
content: Democrats are still holding a slight edge with Election Day a week away, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. And, Israelis are casting their votes in an election that could change leadership.

title: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
content: The German-owned chain's low prices are winning over shoppers — and pushing competitors to respond.
